title: splice-quant-sprint-fieldnotes-jun10-2026
body:
Sprint: Splice-quant (week of 2026-06-08)
Owners: Maya T. (lead), Rafael O. (bench + infra), Priya N. (evals), Ethan C. (model onramp)

Goal this week
- Get a stable 4-bit KV-prefetch quant pipeline for rw-7b-v2 variants and validate there is < 5% relative task-quality degradation on our internal evalset while improving median token latency by >= 25%.
- Prove continuous-batching + prefix cache hit behavior for conversational traces with 95th percentile length <= 256.
- Document minimal onboarding checklist for new open models to avoid repeat infra surprises.

Top-line summary
- Experiment snapshot: splice-quant-4bit-kv-v0.3 produced median token latency 52ms vs baseline int8 74ms (p50 change -30%). p95 latency reduced from 240ms to 180ms under the same load profile (see bench notes).
- Quality: small but measurable degradation on L1-perf subset: mean log-prob drop equivalent to ~1.9% token-level accuracy regression on our conversational QA eval (proxy). Full eval (Lambada-mini + internal QA) shows overall metric delta within 3.7% relative — still within our exploratory threshold but not yet safe for default rollout.
- Two repeatable failure modes found: (A) attention-key alignment errors when using aggressive symmetric quantization on layernorm input (rare, higher perplexity spikes on long-context prompts); (B) cache corruption observed during prefetch under heavy microbatching when a worker hot-swaps model variant mid-epoch.

Standup captures (short bullets)
- Maya: merged infra changes for kv-prefetch circuit breaker; added more verbose KV cache metrics (cache_evictions, cache_staleness_ms).
- Rafael: bench run 2026-06-09-13:00 against 12k synthetic traces. Observed consistent p50/p90 improvement. Repro script in GH PR 128. Need to limit retry backoff to avoid subtle double-counting tokens in audit logs.
- Priya: eval pipeline added stratified sampling for L1/L2 difficulty tiers. Preliminary ROC curves attached to confluence page. Noted distribution shift when generating prompts from customer logs vs synthetic.
- Ethan: onboarding notes for rw-7b-v2: model artifacts required (tokenizer.json, merges, config.json must include seq_len_max), plus special-casing of rotary base params. Missed in initial onboarding and caused inference kernel fallback to slow path.

Experiment log (detailed)
- splice-quant-4bit-kv-v0.1 (Mon-Tue)
  - Setup: GPT-like rw-7b-v2, baseline int8 kernels, enable microbatch size 8, default batching window 20ms.
  - Result: correctness within 1.1% of baseline on small LM eval, latency unchanged.
  - Notes: memory pressure moderate; no failures.

- splice-quant-4bit-kv-v0.2 (Wed)
  - Changed: switched to symmetric per-channel 4-bit with outlier clamp, enabled KV-prefetch when prefix_hit_rate>0.1.
  - Result: median latency down 18%, but spikes in perplexity for longer contexts (>384 tokens) on prompt variants with repeated named entities.
  - Action: added granularity to outlier clamp (per-layer) and disabled for first 2 layers.

- splice-quant-4bit-kv-v0.3 (Thu-Fri)
  - Changed: per-layer clamp + low-precision rotary handling, improved dequant math to avoid small negative zeros; circuit-breaker for KV prefetch when worker model swap detected.
  - Result: p50 -30% latency, p95 -25% latency. Eval delta: ~3.1% relative drop on conv QA proxy; LAMBADA-mini unchanged. Failures reduced but still see 1 in 8k trace with alignment glitch.
  - Note: bench harness logged one reproducible trace causing alignment glitch; reproducer attached to GH PR 131.

Metrics snapshot (representative, see bench csv in linked_artifacts)
- Baseline int8 (microbatch=8): p50=74ms, p95=240ms, median tokens/sec=87
- splice-quant-4bit-kv-v0.3: p50=52ms, p95=180ms, median tokens/sec=125
- Eval: convQA accuracy baseline=0.882, v0.3=0.849 (relative -3.7%)

Open problems / blockers
- Hard to reproduce alignment glitch in isolation; seems sensitive to particular tokenization boundary patterns and edge-case rotary params. (Priya + Rafael investigating.)
- Onboarding doc gaps: some open-source checkpoints omit explicit rotary base -> causes silent fallback. Need an automated check in onramp that verifies expected rotary params exist and warns. (Ethan to propose schema check.)
- Production safety: we cannot enable this new quant pipeline by default for hosted API until regression on customer-proxy eval is <2%. Need more runs on held-out live-like traffic.

Decisions made
- Keep KV-prefetch gated behind circuit breaker: only on instances tagged experimental/kv-prefetch and when cache hit rate >= 10% for 5m sliding window.
- Roll forward v0.3 into a small canary (5% traffic) for internal customers only; no public rollout yet.
- Add 'rotary-presence' check to onboarding: fail early if rotary params ambiguous.

Action items (owner — due)
- Rafael O. — reproduce and pin down alignment glitch; create minimal reproducer and add unit test (due 2026-06-15).
- Priya N. — run full eval suite on 3 additional held-out customer logs and report results + per-slice breakdown (due 2026-06-14).
- Ethan C. — draft onboarding schema check PR for model artifacts + docs for rw-7b-v2 oddities (due 2026-06-12).
- Maya T. — schedule canary rollout with SRE (5% internal) and add tracing hooks for token-level diffs (due 2026-06-13).

Notes-to-self / backlog ideas
- Try non-uniform quant bucketization: more bits for low-amplitude activations in early layers.
- Explore per-request quant-mode hints (client can request high-precision path for financial/legal customers).
- Consider a small 'retrace' mode that replays upstream tokens if alignment glitch detected at decode time.

Questions for next cross-team sync
- SRE: what are safe thresholds for p95 increase before traffic is force-failed? Need concrete numbers for circuit-breaker tuning.
- Console: can we add per-route regression alerts that trigger when model A/B diff > 2% on critical eval sets?

Relevant links
- reproducer + bench: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quant-kv/pull/131
- infra: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/895 (kv-prefetch circuit-breaker)
- onboarding checklist draft: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/AM/Splice-Quant-Sprint

Next week focus
- Harden the dequant math to eliminate alignment edge-case (Rafael + Priya).
- Expand canary to 10% internal if no new regressions (Maya + SRE).
- Finish onboarding schema PR and add automated checks to onramp (Ethan).

Raw observations (scratch)
- Customer prompt set A triggered more alignment issues than synthetic — likely due to concatenated system messages + user agents. Short-term fix: sanitize concatenation step in router.
- Microbatching window tuning: 20ms is sweet spot for retrofit clusters; but for dedicated pools 10ms yields better throughput/LQ tradeoff.

End of notes.

-- Maya
